description: This header file defines B-tree map and multimap container classes (`absl::btree_map` and `absl::btree_multimap`) that are optimized associative containers using B-trees, similar to STL's `std::map` and `std::multimap`. It includes class templates, member functions, and utility functions for these containers, along with internal parameter structures.

classes.name: btree_map
classes.description: A template class implementing an ordered associative container based on B-trees, supporting unique keys and various insertion, deletion, and lookup operations.

classes.name: btree_multimap
classes.description: A template class implementing an ordered multimap container based on B-trees, allowing multiple elements with equivalent keys, with similar interface and operations as `btree_map`.

classes.name: map_params
classes.description: A structure holding type parameters for B-tree map containers, including key, data, comparator, allocator, target node size, and whether it is a multimap.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Function template to swap the contents of two `absl::btree_map` or `absl::btree_multimap` containers.

methods.name: erase_if
methods.description: Function template to erase all elements satisfying a predicate from a `btree_map` or `btree_multimap`, returning the count of erased elements.
